title: AuthorityRecord
description: Records the authority granted to an actor for a specific scope within a run.

authority_id.description: Unique identifier for this authority record.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this authority applies to.

scope.description: List of permission scopes granted, e.g. ['read', 'write'].

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when this authority expires.

source.description: Where the authority was granted from, e.g. 'user_consent'.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this record was created.
